migration_flags.description: uom.uom in v19 defines no category_id field and no uom.category model is used by the unit model; domains and constraints that relied on a shared category must be rewritten. Only a leftover translation entry (uom/i18n/is.po) still names the old field. The v16/v17 side of this statement is UNVERIFIED-FROM-SOURCE.
The bigger/smaller/reference uom_type selection no longer exists; a unit is a node in a tree and a root is simply a unit with no relative_uom_id.

The factor_inv (Bigger Ratio) field is absent in v19; the Contains ratio (relative_factor) on a parent-linked unit replaces it. Direction of the ratio is inverted relative to older versions (v19 side verified, older side UNVERIFIED-FROM-SOURCE), so data migration must recompute rather than copy.
New parent field relative_uom_id (_parent_name) with ondelete cascade, related_uom_ids (inverse One2many), and relative_factor default 1; units form a tree rather than category lists.

factor is a stored recursive compute equal to relative_factor times the parent's factor (or relative_factor for a root); any code that wrote factor directly must write relative_factor and relative_uom_id instead.
_compute_quantity multiplies by the source factor and divides by the target factor; a custom conversion copied from an older release must be re-derived against this direction.
rounding is a non-stored compute equal to 10 to the negative Product Unit decimal precision; per-unit rounding values no longer exist and the two-digit shipped setting gives 0.01 for every unit.
float_utils supports five rounding methods; _compute_quantity defaults to UP while _check_qty defaults to HALF-UP.

The raise_if_failure parameter of _compute_quantity is accepted but never read, its docstring still mentions categories, and seven callers pass it as False; code that relied on an error for incompatible units no longer gets one.

Converting between units that belong to different root trees yields a number silently; _has_common_reference exists as an opt-in check with 14 call sites and must be called explicitly where a guard is needed.
Identical source and target units skip scaling but are still rounded when rounding is requested.
_check_qty (round to whole packagings) has one production caller, the full-packaging reservation in stock.quant.

No addon code defines product.packaging in this release; only leftover translation entries name it. Packaging is expressed by additional units (product.template.uom_ids) plus product.uom barcode link records. The older-version model behaviour is UNVERIFIED-FROM-SOURCE.
purchase.order.line defines neither a packaging selection field nor a packaging quantity field; only leftover translation entries name them.
New model product.uom links unit, product variant, required barcode and company; barcode is unique in the database and also refused when already used by a product.

A packaging is a unit with a relative factor shared by every product that lists it; per-product packaging sizes of older versions have no direct equivalent and must be mapped to units plus barcode links.
product.template carries uom_ids labelled Packagings holding the additional units for a product.
stock.move stores packaging_uom_id and packaging_uom_qty (precomputed); sale_stock, purchase_stock, mrp, sale_mrp and purchase_mrp override the compute.
Route selection consults packaging_uom_id.package_type_id.route_ids after explicit routes and before product, category and warehouse routes.
Put-away selection uses the package type of the package, else the one attached to the packaging unit.

stock.warehouse.orderpoint carries replenishment_uom_id and rounds the order quantity up to a whole multiple via _get_multiple_rounded_qty; the alternative unit hook is overridden by mrp and purchase_stock.

Line models compute allowed_uom_ids from the base unit plus additional units (and seller units where relevant) instead of a category domain; custom domains on uom_id that filter by category must be replaced.
A change to relative_factor, factor or relative_uom_id is refused when open moves or move lines use the unit or when non-zero stock exists for products with that base unit.
Changing the unit on a done stock move raises an error unless the skip_uom_conversion context key is set.
Changing the product unit passes a guard chain across base, sale, purchase, mrp, repair and stock modules; bulk unit changes in migration scripts must account for each guard.
Shipped units other than hour, dozen and pack_6 are protected by _unprotected_uom_xml_ids; hr_timesheet protects hour.
stock.move, stock.warehouse.orderpoint and repair.order use product_uom; most other models use uom_id or product_uom_id; product.template uses a third form. Integrations need a per-model map.
Point of sale loads product.uom records and resolves scanned packaging barcodes through them.
uom.uom has 9 ACL rows across 7 CSV files and product.uom has 2 rows; no ir.rule restricts either model.
l10n_th ships no unit-of-measure data; Thai unit names and conversions must come from custom data.
Some docstrings and translation files still use category wording although the field no longer exists; wording alone is not evidence of a category model.

key_findings.reference_unit_tree: uom.uom is a tree via relative_uom_id with relative_factor (Contains); no category and no type selection; root requires ratio exactly 1
key_findings.absolute_factor_stored: factor is a stored recursive compute: relative_factor times parent factor
key_findings.global_rounding: rounding is non-stored and equals 10 to the negative Product Unit decimal precision for all units
key_findings.conversion: _compute_quantity multiplies by source factor, divides by target factor, rounds UP by default; raise_if_failure is never read; unrelated trees convert silently
key_findings.packaging_replacement: No product.packaging model; packaging is additional units (uom_ids) plus product.uom barcode links plus stock.move packaging_uom_id and packaging_uom_qty
key_findings.routing_and_replenishment: package_type_id on units steers route selection; orderpoint replenishment_uom_id rounds order quantity up to a multiple
key_findings.reservation: Category packaging_reserve_method full uses _check_qty with DOWN rounding at stock/models/stock_quant.py:851-853
key_findings.field_naming: product_uom on stock.move, orderpoint and repair; suffixed names elsewhere; template uses a third form
key_findings.write_lock: stock blocks ratio or reference changes while open moves or stock use the unit
key_findings.older_version_side: v16 and v17 statements are UNVERIFIED-FROM-SOURCE; only the v19 side was read
